material.description: js/client/play.js:1163 setStatus('order move unit..'), :1908 peer-open, :1682 state_hash vs :225 'assets failed to load', :419 'game stopped'; play.html:157 #status role=status aria-live=polite. Symptom: players read telemetry; a fatal 'game stopped' is overwritten by the next order line; screen readers announce every order. Acceptance: separate sticky error region from a debug channel (behind ?debug), live region announces errors only. Witness: stop game then order; error text remains.

notes.note: hud-start-1: status line is one short line; telemetry goes to console and oscraft.statusLog(); fatal lines pinned in #fatal until dismissed. Witness: verify-ui-status-line-mixes-debug-and-fatal-text dispatches 1792959128550-199-2897691f7611dff1 (pinned asset errors, short line) and 1792960522677-227-6cda075b56a413c9 (pinned before dismiss, cleared after).

Local work is complete and witnessed; nothing is pushed. Clearing action: a git fetch of origin main that completes from this host. Commit plan waits on it: play.js world_ready (row lobby-start-world-ready-never-fires-headful), play.js+play.html boot card (ui-loading-experience-text-only), play.js+debug_api.js status (ui-status-line-mixes-debug-and-fatal-text), play.js relay retry (relay-drop-retry-backoff), modui.js guard (ui-modui-poll-overlaps-duplicates-events), play.html phone modal (ui-phone-lobby-overflows).

material.subject: #status shows per-order debug lines and hashes, and the next write erases fatal errors
material.witness: Leader hypothesis: the fix at dcc1cba3 (no role/aria-live on #status; statusLine shown only with ?debug; FATAL_STATUS lines pinned in role=alert #fatal; telemetry() never writes the DOM) meets the acceptance. gpu-free witness: play.js lines 198-242 run in a vm with DOM stubs; setStatus(game stopped) then telemetry(order) keeps #fatal text and visibility in both debug modes; order text never reaches #status; status line count 1 without ?debug and 2 with it; removing the gate or the fatal route each makes the probe fail. Served https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html has <div id="status"> with no role or aria-live. ci-status dcc1cba3: pages run 40943014591 success 3/3. End-to-end browser stop-then-order witness not run (browser lease held by another pid).
